title: Athenaeum core — storage, endpoints, limits
summary: Build the remote service immediately after the shared contract so later client work can exercise a live endpoint.

specReferences.heading: W10 · Athenaeum core — storage, endpoints, limits

produces: Create, lookup, blob, manifest, and deletion endpoints
A deployed live endpoint for client development

conditions: The service consumes W5's shared id_key definition before C2.
Create and lookup remain distinct and issue fresh epochs correctly.
Blobs are immutable and stale epochs are rejected.
ETag, content type, credential decoding, and budget accounting pass.
A live loopback test deployment is available before W6 client-engine work begins.
completion.summary: The Shelf Athenaeum service is implemented with shared W5 identity derivation, epoch-scoped storage, typed endpoints, allocation-safe limits, and live loopback coverage.
evidence: server/lib/src/athenaeum_app.dart consumes compendium_core's W5 deriveIncomingSyncIdKey and server/test/athenaeum_app_test.dart verifies equivalent normalized IDs resolve consistently.
server/test/athenaeum_app_test.dart covers distinct GET/POST creation, fresh epochs, duplicate creation conflicts, concurrent creators, and delete/recreate reset behavior.

server/lib/src/athenaeum_store.dart namespaces SQLite rows and blob paths by id_key and epoch; tests cover stale manifest rejection, immutable duplicate blobs, cross-store isolation, and concurrent identical uploads.

server/test/athenaeum_app_test.dart covers strong ETags/304, content-type handling, malformed credential 401s, all four failure-resolution outcomes, saturated existing-store access, and separate creation limits.

server/bin/athenaeum.dart and server/test/athenaeum_app_test.dart provide a real loopback listening endpoint for the C2 HTTP round trip; server tests, analyzers, core tests, and available preflight gates pass. The loopback-only interpretation is the W10/W16 boundary; public deployment remains W16.
